caption: The drawing depicts a wooden ship figurehead in the form of a male bust, dressed in historical attire. The figure is shown from the chest up and turned slightly to the left (from the viewer’s perspective). He wears a brown coat or tunic with a broad strap crossing his torso from his right shoulder to his left side. Over his left shoulder is draped a blue garment or cloak. The figure’s head is topped with a dark gray wide-brimmed hat, adorned with a white feather on the right side. Facial features include a long mustache, a pointed beard, and long brown hair extending to his shoulders. The background is a plain, light cream color, and there are no other objects or details in the drawing except for the outlined figurehead.
title: Figurehead
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
